title: Refining Coarse-Grained Molecular Topologies: A Bayesian Optimization Approach
abstract: This work introduces a Bayesian Optimization-based approach to refine Martini3 topologies for specialized applications, ensuring accuracy and efficiency. The resulting optimized CG potential accommodates any degree of polymerization, offering accuracy comparable to AA simulations while retaining the computational speed of CGMD.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're trying to understand how a complex molecule behaves. You could simulate every single atom, but that's computationally expensive. Instead, we use coarse-graining, which simplifies the molecule into representative beads. However, this simplification can lead to inaccuracies. Our approach uses Bayesian Optimization to refine these coarse-grained models, making them more accurate and efficient.

Think of it like trying to find the best route to a destination. You could try every possible path, but that would take forever. Instead, you use a map to guide you, and our approach is like using a highly accurate map to find the optimal parameters for our molecular models.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
Our approach works by using Bayesian Optimization to optimize the parameters of the coarse-grained model. We use a Gaussian Process surrogate model to approximate the objective function, which is the difference between the coarse-grained and all-atom simulations. We then use the Expected Hypervolume Improvement acquisition function to select the next parameters to evaluate.

This process is repeated until convergence, resulting in a refined coarse-grained model that accurately captures the behavior of the molecule.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
We tested our approach on three common polymers: PE, PMMA, and PS. We compared the results to the raw Martini3 model and found that our optimized model reduces the error by up to 30%.

The results show that our approach is effective in refining the coarse-grained model, making it more accurate and efficient.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
Our approach has significant implications for molecular simulations. By refining the coarse-grained model, we can accurately capture the behavior of complex molecules, which is crucial for understanding their properties and behavior.

This can lead to breakthroughs in fields such as materials science, chemistry, and biology, where molecular simulations play a critical role.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
Our approach introduces several key innovations, including the use of Bayesian Optimization to refine the coarse-grained model, and the use of a Gaussian Process surrogate model to approximate the objective function.

These innovations enable our approach to efficiently and accurately refine the coarse-grained model, making it a powerful tool for molecular simulations.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
Our approach is implemented in a Python package, making it easy to use and integrate into existing workflows. We provide examples and tutorials to help users get started.

Try it out and see how our approach can improve your molecular simulations!
